transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I'd like to get started on finalizing the casting and rehearsal package for our concert pilot. As I understand it, we need one lead performer and one named understudy for the principal vocal role, and our shortlist is Sable, Rowan, and Tessa — all three have completed the standard audition process. We also have one full-day rehearsal provisionally held before filming. Before I can issue the binding casting and rehearsal package, I need the final reports from the show director, the contracts coordinator, and the company manager. Could each of you walk me through where things stand on your end?
